coverage.name: Re-run hides results
coverage.evidence: isExecuting branch in apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/UtilityPanel/UtilityTabResults.tsx:41-47 replaces the grid with 'Running...' until new rows arrive.
coverage.notes: Keeping stale rows dimmed under a progress bar would be nicer; nothing is lost because the new result replaces it.

coverage.name: Results offline
coverage.evidence: fetchHandler in apps/studio/data/fetchers.ts:22 turns 'Failed to fetch' into 'Unable to reach the server. Please check your network or try again later.', rendered as mono 'Error: ...' at UtilityTabResults.tsx:95 — missing: offline-specific copy and a Retry action (isNetWorkError at :39 only suppresses the limit note).
coverage.gap_label: Extend UtilityTabResults error branch, add network-error copy + Retry button
coverage.consequence_reason: The SQL text stays in the editor; pressing Run again once connected recovers it, nothing is lost.
coverage.notes: The EHOSTUNREACH case is really 'database host unreachable', covered under state 122.

coverage.name: Very large result
coverage.evidence: react-data-grid (virtualized) in apps/studio/components/ui/DataGridResults/index.tsx:3; rows wrapped in ref() to avoid proxy overhead at apps/studio/state/sql-editor/sql-editor-session-state.ts:46; 'Query is too large' handled at UtilityTabResults.tsx:53-120.

coverage.name: Long-running query, no cancel
coverage.evidence: SqlRunButton only swaps to a spinner and is disabled while executing (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/UtilityPanel/RunButton.tsx:36-44, UtilityActions.tsx:298); cancel exists only on another page via useQueryCancelMutation (apps/studio/data/sql/cancel-query-mutation.ts:40, used in components/interfaces/Observability/DatabaseConnections/ActivityRow.tsx) behind the 'View running queries' link (apps/studio/components/layouts/SQLEditorLayout/SQLEditorMenu.tsx:181) — missing: Stop button in the editor.
coverage.gap_label: Reuse useQueryCancelMutation + Button for a Stop state on the Run button
coverage.consequence_reason: A runaway statement keeps running (and holding locks) on the live database; refreshing the page does not cancel it server-side and Run stays disabled until timeout, so the user can't stop it from the editor.
coverage.notes: Workaround via Observability > Connections is why this is half-built rather than missing.

coverage.name: Target database unclear
coverage.evidence: DatabaseSelector and RoleImpersonationPopover sit directly left of Run (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/UtilityPanel/UtilityActions.tsx:256-268); read-replica write errors get a 'Switch to primary database' action (UtilityTabResults.tsx:103-135). RunQueryWarningModal (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/RunQueryWarningModal.tsx:141-151) doesn't name the target.
coverage.notes: Worth restating database + role inside the destructive-query warning dialog; the current target is visible, so not a bug.

coverage.name: Results lost on reload
coverage.evidence: Results are intentionally ephemeral per sql-editor-session-state.ts:6-17 (not persisted); after refresh UtilityTabResults.tsx shows 'Click Run to execute your query'.
coverage.notes: Re-running a SELECT recovers the rows; persisting large result sets locally is a design trade-off.

coverage.name: Multiple statements result
coverage.evidence: addResult stores a single entry per snippet (sql-editor-session-state.ts:52) and UtilityPanel.tsx:58 reads results[id][0]; only the final statement's rows are shown, with no label.
coverage.notes: Consistent with Postgres simple-query behaviour; a caption like 'Showing result of last statement' would remove the ambiguity.

coverage.name: Undetected destructive query
coverage.evidence: destructiveSqlRegex (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/SQLEditor.constants.ts:40-50) only matches DROP/DELETE/TRUNCATE at the start or right after ';' or inside EXECUTE strings, so 'WITH d AS (DELETE FROM t RETURNING *) SELECT 1' and 'DO $$ BEGIN DELETE FROM t; END $$' pass checkDestructiveQuery (SQLEditor.utils.ts:127) and run without the RunQueryWarningModal.
coverage.gap_label: Extend destructiveSqlRegex/analyzeQueryIssues to catch CTE and DO-block statements
coverage.consequence_reason: Users learn the warning dialog as a safety net, so its silence reads as 'this is safe'; the statement runs irreversibly on the live database and neither retry nor refresh undoes it.

coverage.name: Snippet fetch failed
coverage.evidence: apps/studio/pages/project/[ref]/sql/[id].tsx:48-58 handles only 404 'Content not found' and 400 'Invalid uuid' (with retry:false); any other error leaves content undefined so deriveSnippetIdentity (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/SQLEditor.utils.ts:332) keeps isLoading true and SQLEditorEditorPanel.tsx:190 shows LoadingSpinner forever.
coverage.gap_label: Reuse the invalid-id Admonition + Button branch for a generic load error with Retry
coverage.consequence_reason: The snippet is safe on the server; a manual refresh refetches it once the API recovers, so nothing is lost, only time spent watching a spinner.

coverage.name: Snippet from other project
coverage.evidence: Mismatch branch at apps/studio/pages/project/[ref]/sql/[id].tsx:73-77 calls router.replace('/sql/new') silently, while the deleted-snippet case right below shows a toast ('no longer exists. Opened a new query instead', [id].tsx:150) — missing: the same toast here.
coverage.gap_label: Reuse toast from the deleted-snippet branch with 'belongs to another project' copy
coverage.consequence_reason: A blank new query with no explanation implies the snippet is gone; refreshing repeats the same redirect, so the user can't tell they need to switch projects.

coverage.name: Manual save failed
coverage.evidence: persistSnippet sets status save_failed but never notifies (apps/studio/state/sql-editor/sql-editor-save.ts:103-105); in manual mode AutosaveStatus shows only 'Unsaved edits' (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/UtilityPanel/AutosaveStatus.tsx:31-36) and SavingIndicator's red AlertCircle + Retry is hidden (UtilityActions.tsx:110) — missing: a failure state in manual mode.
coverage.gap_label: Extend AutosaveStatus with the SavingIndicator failure state (AlertCircle + 'Failed to save' + Retry) in manual mode
coverage.consequence_reason: After Cmd+S the label says 'Unsaved edits' as if the keystroke didn't register, so users retry blindly or assume a later save will work; the beforeunload guard (sql-editor-save-coordinator.tsx:133-146) protects the edits, but retrying fails again silently for persistent causes.

coverage.name: No permission to save
coverage.evidence: ReadOnlyBadge exists but only for snippets the user doesn't own (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/UtilityPanel/ReadOnlyBadge.tsx:12-15); lacking CREATE on user_content only triggers a one-off toast on New (apps/studio/components/layouts/SQLEditorLayout/SQLEditorMenu.tsx:76, apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/hooks.ts:40) — missing: a persistent read-only notice in the editor.
coverage.gap_label: Extend ReadOnlyBadge to show when canCreateSQLSnippet is false, with a tooltip
coverage.consequence_reason: The editor looks fully editable and autosave's Retry suggests a temporary problem, but saves will never succeed; refresh or retry doesn't change the permission, and the typed SQL is lost when the tab closes.

coverage.name: Concurrent edits conflict
coverage.evidence: persistSnippet sends the whole snippet with no version, updated_at or If-Match check (apps/studio/state/sql-editor/sql-editor-save.ts:91-107); no BroadcastChannel/storage listener in state/sql-editor or SQLEditor/.
coverage.gap_label: New conflict detection (compare server updated_at before upsert) + conflict notice
coverage.consequence_reason: Both tabs show 'Saved' while the later save silently overwrites the other's SQL; the overwritten work isn't recoverable by refresh.
coverage.notes: Only affects the owner editing one snippet in two tabs/sessions; lower reach than other misleading items.

coverage.name: Empty-list copy wrong in manual mode
coverage.evidence: EmptyPrivateQueriesPanel says 'Queries will be automatically saved once you start writing in the editor' unconditionally (apps/studio/components/layouts/SQLEditorLayout/PrivateSqlSnippetEmpty.tsx:8) — missing: a manual-mode variant.
coverage.gap_label: Reuse InnerSideBarEmptyPanel with copy switched on useIsSqlEditorManualSaveEnabled
coverage.consequence_reason: The panel states something false under manual save, so new users may close tabs expecting autosave; the close-tab confirm is the only thing that catches them.

coverage.name: Snippet list fetch failed
coverage.evidence: Error only fires a toast (apps/studio/components/layouts/SQLEditorLayout/SQLEditorNavV2/SQLEditorNav.tsx:174-180); the panel then falls through to EmptyPrivateQueriesPanel 'No private queries created yet' (SQLEditorNav.tsx:683-686) — missing: an error branch with Retry.
coverage.gap_label: Extend the private-snippets section with an error branch (Admonition + Retry)
extends_from: refetch from the private snippets infinite query
coverage.consequence_reason: Snippets are safe on the server; refreshing refetches the list once the API recovers, though the empty copy briefly suggests they're gone.

coverage.name: Search failed
coverage.evidence: SearchList ignores error from useSqlSnippetsQuery (apps/studio/components/layouts/SQLEditorLayout/SQLEditorNavV2/SearchList.tsx:60-69) and shows 'No queries found' when not loading (SearchList.tsx:127-129); no error branch found.
coverage.gap_label: Reuse Admonition + Retry in SearchList error branch
coverage.consequence_reason: Retyping the search or refreshing recovers it; nothing is lost.

coverage.name: Export unsaved snippet
coverage.evidence: DownloadSnippetModal only builds 'supabase snippets download <id>' CLI commands (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/DownloadSnippetModal.tsx:55-80, SQLEditor.utils.ts:338-354), which fetch the server copy; no check of hasUnsavedChanges and no notice in the modal.
coverage.gap_label: Extend DownloadSnippetModal with a warning Admonition + Save action when the snippet has unsaved edits
coverage.consequence_reason: In manual-save mode the migration/seed file silently gets the older server SQL, which the user may then apply to production believing it matches the editor.

coverage.name: Delete folder failed
coverage.evidence: useSQLSnippetFoldersDeleteMutation defaults to toast.error('Failed to delete folder: ...') when no onError is passed (apps/studio/data/content/sql-folders-delete-mutation.ts:55-57); SQLEditorNav.tsx:339 relies on it.
coverage.notes: Dialog stays open so the user can retry.

coverage.name: Many tabs overflow
coverage.evidence: Tab strip uses 'overflow-x-auto' with a pinned segment outside the scroll area (apps/studio/components/layouts/Tabs/Tabs.tsx:195-200).

coverage.name: AI diff accept fails silently
coverage.evidence: acceptAiHandler returns early with a 'TODO: show error if undefined' when editor/diff isn't ready (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/useSqlEditorAi.ts:156).
coverage.notes: Narrow race while Monaco mounts; clicking Accept again works. A toast.error would close the TODO.

coverage.name: Editor chunk loading
coverage.evidence: MonacoEditor/DiffEditor loaded via dynamic() with no loading option (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/SQLEditorEditorPanel.tsx:20-27); the compat dynamic renders Suspense fallback null (apps/studio/compat/next/dynamic.tsx:49).
coverage.notes: Reuse the existing LoadingSpinner (SQLEditorEditorPanel.tsx:175) as the fallback. Poor connectivity isn't normal for these users; collapsed under state 120.

coverage.name: Chart with no results
coverage.evidence: NoDataPlaceholder 'Execute a query and configure the chart options.' when there are no result keys (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/UtilityPanel/ChartConfig.tsx:110-118).

coverage.name: Toast stack
coverage.evidence: Single SonnerToaster (packages/ui/src/components/shadcn/ui/sonner.tsx:13) mounted once in apps/studio/pages/_app.tsx:226; Sonner stacks and caps visible toasts by default.

coverage.name: First-time
coverage.evidence: Editor placeholder 'Hit CMD+SHIFT+K to generate query or just start typing' (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/SQLEditorEditorPanel.tsx:29-30), EmptyPrivateQueriesPanel (apps/studio/components/layouts/SQLEditorLayout/PrivateSqlSnippetEmpty.tsx:5), Templates/Examples sections (apps/studio/components/layouts/SQLEditorLayout/SQLEditorNavV2/ReferenceSnippetsSection.tsx:48) and 'Click Run to execute your query' (UtilityTabResults.tsx:160-166).
coverage.notes: Quick-scan found no onboarding keywords, but the empty states and templates cover it. The empty panel's autosave copy is wrong in manual mode (state 54).

coverage.name: Offline
coverage.evidence: No navigator.onLine/offline listener in SQLEditor/, SQLEditorLayout/ or state/sql-editor; React Query v5 (package.json ~5.83) pauses mutations while offline by default (no networkMode override in apps/studio/data/query-client.ts), so a Run while offline leaves isPending true and UtilityTabResults.tsx:41-47 shows 'Running...' until reconnect, then fires.
coverage.gap_label: New offline banner + offline-aware Run state
coverage.consequence_reason: The results panel claims the query is running when nothing was sent, and it may execute later on reconnect against the live database; autosave failures only show a small icon. Retrying doesn't clarify what's happening.
coverage.notes: Autosave failure does get the AlertCircle + Retry in auto mode (SavingIndicator.tsx:49-80), so edits aren't silently dropped.

coverage.name: Slow connection
coverage.evidence: Request timeouts exist (apps/studio/data/fetchers.ts:399, 60s) and statement/upstream timeouts get tailored copy (UtilityTabResults.tsx:34-85); Monaco chunk has a blank fallback (state 110) and runs show only a spinner.
coverage.notes: Includes state 110. context.poor_connectivity_is_normal: no, so elapsed-time hints are an enhancement.

coverage.name: Session expired
coverage.evidence: SessionTimeoutModal ('Session expired', apps/studio/components/interfaces/SignIn/SessionTimeoutModal.tsx:56) via hooks/misc/withAuth.tsx:106, and 401 sign-out in apps/studio/lib/profile.tsx:93 — missing: any local draft of snippet content; sqlEditorState is an in-memory valtio proxy (apps/studio/state/sql-editor/sql-editor-state.ts:19) with no localStorage persistence.
coverage.gap_label: Extend the save coordinator to persist dirty snippets to safeLocalStorage and restore after sign-in
coverage.consequence_reason: In manual mode, and for edits whose autosave failed after expiry, the SQL lives only in memory; the modal's 'Clear site data and reload' or any full reload on the way back from sign-in discards it, and refresh can't bring it back (context.unsaved_work: partly).

coverage.name: Project paused or unhealthy
coverage.evidence: ProjectLayout renders ProjectPausedState, RestoringState, UpgradingState etc. for reported statuses (apps/studio/components/layouts/ProjectLayout/index.tsx:219-226, 464-472) — missing: copy for an ACTIVE project whose database is unreachable; EHOSTUNREACH is detected (UtilityTabResults.tsx:39) but the raw error is printed.
coverage.gap_label: Extend UtilityTabResults error branch with 'database unreachable' copy + link to project status
coverage.consequence_reason: Running again once the database is back recovers it and the SQL stays in the editor; the raw error just slows the user down.

coverage.name: Stale app version
coverage.evidence: Persisted tabs are shape-checked and fall back to defaults on bad data (apps/studio/state/tabs.tsx:176-192); no 'new version available' prompt found.
coverage.notes: Old persisted state degrades safely; a reload prompt after deploy is an enhancement.

coverage.name: Keyboard navigation
coverage.evidence: Cmd+Enter/Cmd+S shortcuts (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/useSqlEditorShortcuts.ts:76), focus-ring utilities and Radix dialogs cover most paths — missing: the timeout/payload-too-large 'connect to your database directly' actions are <span onClick> without role or tabIndex (apps/studio/components/interfaces/SQLEditor/UtilityPanel/UtilityTabResults.tsx:77-82, 112-118).
coverage.gap_label: Reuse InlineLink/Button (asChild) for the two direct-connection actions
coverage.consequence_reason: Keyboard users can still open Connect from the page header, so they can get unstuck; nothing is lost.

coverage.name: Screen reader
coverage.evidence: Live-region patterns exist in the DS (packages/ui/src/components/shadcn/ui/alert.tsx:37 role=alert) and controls have aria-labels (SQLEditorMenu.tsx:101, SqlTabStatusIndicator role=img 'Unsaved changes') — missing: no aria-live/role=status anywhere in SQLEditor/ or DataGridResults, so 'Running...', errors and 'Success. No rows returned' aren't announced.
coverage.gap_label: Reuse role=status/aria-live on the UtilityTabResults status line
coverage.consequence_reason: Screen reader users can move to the results panel to read the outcome; nothing is lost, it just takes extra navigation.

coverage.name: High contrast
coverage.evidence: No forced-colors/prefers-contrast rules found in apps/studio/styles or packages/config/css; the unsaved dot also carries aria-label (SqlTabStatusIndicator.tsx) and errors are printed as text in the results panel, so meaning isn't colour-only.
coverage.notes: Enhancement: forced-colors styles for the Monaco error-line decoration.

coverage.name: Reduced motion
coverage.evidence: prefers-reduced-motion handled for shimmer (packages/config/css/utilities.css:176) and tabs (packages/ui/src/components/shadcn/ui/tabs.tsx:56); Loader2 animate-spin spinners in RunButton.tsx:38 and UtilityTabResults.tsx:44 are not reduced.
coverage.notes: Small spinners are low-risk; add motion-reduce:animate-none for completeness.
